name: GitHub Copilot SDK — via Foundry project endpoint
summary: Copilot SDK BYOK provider pointed at the Foundry project /openai/v1/ URL with a `{conn}/{model}` BYOM prefix in the model field.
description: The GitHub Copilot SDK (github/copilot-sdk) supports BYOK against OpenAI-compatible endpoints. If you point it at the Foundry **project-level** endpoint (`{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/`) and pass `model="{apim-conn}/{deployment}"`, Foundry should parse the prefix and route to the APIM connection the same way it does for direct Responses API calls. Auth path is static-credential only (`apiKey` or `bearerToken`), so Entra flows require a caller-managed refresh loop.
notes:
BYOM is not verified yet because `model="{conn}/{deployment}"` may be stripped or rejected across Copilot SDK validation, JSON-RPC, CLI, or Responses API.

**Endpoint gotcha:** the `byok.md` sample uses `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/`, which is account-level AOAI and cannot see Foundry connections. BYOM prefixes 404 there. Use the project URL: `https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>/openai/v1/`.

**Auth gotcha:** `bearerToken` is static; the SDK never refreshes it. Workable pattern: refresh Entra via `az account get-access-token --resource https://ai.azure.com` about 5 minutes before expiry and recreate the session.

Requires `wire_api: "responses"`.
